meta.project: Real-Time AI/ML-Based Quishing and Smishing Detection & Prevention System

product_overview: A privacy-first mobile cybersecurity platform that detects and prevents smishing and quishing using on-device AI, with optional backend synchronization for authentication, telemetry, feedback, and admin oversight. The system provides real-time threat scoring, explainable alerts, offline-first protection, and a centralized admin console for monitoring and incident response.
core_goals: Detect suspicious SMS and QR-based phishing attempts in real time on Android devices.
Keep core detection functional offline with local AI inference and local history storage.
Provide clear risk scores, explanations, and recommended actions for every analyzed threat.
Support Firebase-based authentication, role-based access control, and secure backend synchronization.
Enable users to review history, submit feedback, and manage protection settings.
Provide admins with protected threat monitoring, analytics, model integrity checks, and incident management.

features.name: System Health & Operational Probes
features.description: Expose service health, readiness, and root metadata so clients and operators can verify service availability and backend dependency status.
user_flows: GET /health/live -> Receive 200 with liveness status object
GET /health/ready -> Receive 200 with readiness object including DB/auth/model checks
GET / -> Receive 200 with root service information and version
GET /health/ready when database or model integrity check fails -> Receive 503 Service Unavailable with failure details

features.name: Authentication and Authorization
features.description: Verify Firebase or development tokens, establish the current user identity, and return role-aware account information for protected backend access.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/v1/auth/verify with valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user object -> GET /api/v1/v1/auth/me with token -> Receive 200 with current user identity and RBAC role
POST /api/v1/v1/auth/verify without token or with invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/v1/v1/auth/me with expired or missing token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Threat Detections & Telemetry Ingestion
features.description: Store and query user-specific SMS and QR threat events, including risk scores, reasons, and defensive actions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/v1/detections with valid threat payload and token -> Receive 201 Created -> GET /api/v1/v1/detections -> Receive 200 with paginated personal detections -> GET /api/v1/v1/detections/stats -> Receive 200 with user detection summary

POST /api/v1/v1/detections/{detection_id}/action with BLOCK_SENDER or COPY_SAFE_LINK -> Receive 200 with recorded defensive action -> GET /api/v1/v1/detections/{detection_id} -> Receive 200 with updated record
POST /api/v1/v1/detections with malformed payload or invalid risk score -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/v1/v1/detections/{detection_id} for another user's record -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /api/v1/v1/detections without valid authorization -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Threat Intelligence & Reputation Lookup
features.description: Check URLs against threat intelligence feeds and expose admin health metrics for feed synchronization and operational status.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/v1/threat-intel/lookup with valid URL and token -> Receive 200 with reputation result and risk context
GET /api/v1/v1/admin/threat-intel/health as admin -> Receive 200 with feed sync status and health metrics
POST /api/v1/v1/threat-intel/lookup with malformed URL -> Receive 400 Validation error
GET /api/v1/v1/admin/threat-intel/health as non-admin user -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/v1/v1/threat-intel/lookup without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: SOC Incident Management
features.description: Create, inspect, filter, and transition security incidents for analyst workflows, including metrics and state transitions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents with valid title, severity, and summary as admin -> Receive 201 Created -> GET /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents -> Receive 200 with filtered incident list -> GET /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents/metrics -> Receive 200 with MTTT and MTTR metrics

GET /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents/{incident_id} as admin -> Receive 200 with incident dossier and linked threat events -> PATCH /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents/{incident_id}/status with valid transition -> Receive 200 with updated lifecycle status
POST /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 400 Validation error
PATCH /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents/{incident_id}/status with illegal transition -> Receive 400 Invalid Transition
GET /api/v1/v1/admin/incidents as non-admin user -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: User Feedback & False Positive Reporting
features.description: Allow authenticated users to submit and review feedback about detections for model improvement and analyst review.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/v1/feedback with threat_event_id, feedback_type, and comments -> Receive 201 Created -> GET /api/v1/v1/feedback -> Receive 200 with user's feedback submissions
POST /api/v1/v1/feedback without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/v1/v1/feedback with valid token but no submissions -> Receive 200 with an empty or paginated list

features.name: Model Integrity & Operations
features.description: List registered AI models, fetch model metadata, and trigger cryptographic verification of stored artifacts.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/v1/models -> Receive 200 with model registry list -> GET /api/v1/v1/models/{model_id} -> Receive 200 with model metadata and hashes
POST /api/v1/v1/admin/operations/verify-models as admin -> Receive 200 with verification results for all models
GET /api/v1/v1/models/{model_id} for unknown model -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /api/v1/v1/admin/operations/verify-models as non-admin user -> Receive 403 Forbidden
